name: Pork Belly Pie
summary: In Elwynn Forest, Billy Maclure waits for a pie from Stonefield Farm before he speaks of a missing necklace. Auntie Bernice bakes it despite the families’ long feud.

sections.title: A Bribe Between Feuding Farms
sections.body: The Stonefield and Maclure families have quarreled over land and pride for years. Young Billy Maclure has a weakness for Auntie Bernice’s pork belly pie. When a valuable Stonefield family necklace goes missing, Billy refuses to share what he knows until an adventurer brings him a warm slice. Bernice bakes it reluctantly, wishing the greedy boy would choke on it.

faq.q: What is the Pork Belly Pie used for?
aliases: what do i do with the pie
faq.answer: Auntie Bernice Stonefield bakes the pie to get young Billy Maclure to talk. He knows something about the missing Stonefield family necklace, but refuses to speak until he gets her cooking.

faq.q: Who bakes the Pork Belly Pie?
faq.answer: Auntie Bernice Stonefield bakes the pie at Stonefield Farm. She resents Billy Maclure and his family, but prepares it to help recover her family's lost necklace.

faq.q: Why does Billy Maclure want food from a rival family?
faq.answer: Billy Maclure wants Auntie Bernice's cooking despite the feud between the Stonefields and the Maclures. He wants pork belly pie more than he cares about keeping his family's grudge.

faq.q: Can players eat the Pork Belly Pie?
faq.answer: No. The pie is meant for Billy Maclure and cannot be eaten to restore health or mana.

angles.text: Auntie Bernice's home-cooked pie holds sway even amid the families' feud, though her recipe remains a secret.
For Alliance travelers helping in rural Elwynn, delivering pies reveals the deep-rooted quarrels in Stormwind's farming heartland.
